fusions.name: Judged Distance
fusions.desc: A drilled kick at a target up to 3 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Your movement speed rises 6% for 2 seconds after each use.

fusions.name: Flawless Rear
fusions.desc: You rear and stamp, dealing 32 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Run the Drill Again
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Rote Gait
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 3% faster per stack (16% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
